articles.title: Welcome to You-Nique Training — Inclusive Fitness for All Abilities
articles.author: Rayners Lane FC
articles.excerpt: THE LANE WELCOMES YOU-NIQUE TRAINING AS A COMMUNITY PARTNER — INCLUSIVE, DISABILITY-FRIENDLY FITNESS FOR EVERYONE
articles.body:
Rayners Lane FC is proud to welcome You-Nique Training as a Community Partner.

As an FA Charter Standard Community Club, inclusion is at the heart of what we do — and You-Nique Training shares that ethos. Led by certified Level 3 personal trainer Amar Rai, You-Nique offers fitness for everyone, with disability-friendly programmes and a genuine 'all abilities welcome' approach.

Whether you are just starting out or getting back into training, You-Nique covers weight loss and fat burning, muscle building and toning, beginner and disability-friendly programmes, 1-to-1 and small-group sessions, and custom nutrition guidance.

Book a free consultation:

• WhatsApp or call 07534 788 777
• Email info@youniquetraining.co.uk

You-Nique Training is an independent community partner of Rayners Lane FC. Up The Lane.

articles.title: Pre Season News
articles.author: Russell Nugent
articles.excerpt: PRE-SEASON RETURNS TO TITHE FARM AS RAYNERS LANE HOST HAYES & YEADING UNITED
articles.body:
The wait is over.

Rayners Lane FC return to action on Saturday 4 July as we welcome Hayes & Yeading United to Tithe Farm Sports & Social Club for our opening pre-season fixture ahead of the new campaign.

Kick-off is scheduled for 3:00pm as preparations begin for what promises to be another exciting season for the Lane.

Pre-season is about more than results. It is the opportunity to build fitness, integrate new faces, sharpen performances and reconnect with supporters after the summer break. There is no better way to begin than against one of the most respected names in local non-league football.

Hayes & Yeading United carry a proud footballing heritage and remain one of the area’s most recognisable clubs. Built upon the histories of both Hayes FC and Yeading FC, the club has enjoyed memorable moments on the national stage while continuing to play an important role within the non-league game.

Everyone at Rayners Lane FC extends a warm welcome to the players, staff, volunteers and supporters of Hayes & Yeading United ahead of Saturday’s fixture.

As two clubs with deep roots in Middlesex football, encounters such as these celebrate the strength of the local game and provide the perfect platform to begin preparations for the season ahead.

We look forward to welcoming supporters back to Tithe Farm Sports & Social Club and seeing the Lane faithful out in force once again.

Match Details

Rayners Lane FC vs Hayes & Yeading United

Saturday 4 July

Tithe Farm Sports & Social Club

Kick-Off: 3:00pm

Football is back. Up The Lane.

articles.title: Club Update: Building for an Exciting Return to Step 5
articles.author: Russell Nugent
articles.body:
There is a real sense of excitement around Rayners Lane FC as preparations continue for the upcoming season and our return to Step 5 football.

Behind the scenes, the club has been working tirelessly to ensure every aspect of the football operation is moving in the right direction. From strengthening the squad to enhancing the overall structure around the first team, the foundations are being laid for what promises to be an exciting new chapter in the club’s journey.

Pre-season trials have attracted a fantastic level of interest, with players demonstrating tremendous quality, commitment, and hunger to be part of the project. The coaching staff have been encouraged by the standard on display and are continuing to assess the talent available as they look to assemble a competitive squad capable of meeting the demands of Step 5 football.

Returning to this level presents a challenge that everyone at the club is embracing. It is an opportunity to test ourselves against strong opposition, showcase the ambitions of Rayners Lane FC, and continue building a team that our supporters can be proud of.

While there is still plenty of hard work ahead, the energy around the club is undeniable. Players, staff, volunteers, sponsors, and supporters all have a vital role to play as we embark on this exciting journey together.

We would like to thank everyone for their continued support and look forward to welcoming you back as we begin the next chapter for Rayners Lane FC.

The future is taking shape, and we cannot wait to get started.

articles.title: The Lane Goes Digital — A New Era for Rayners Lane FC
articles.author: Russell Nugent
articles.excerpt: Pete Singh commissioned former committee member and creative director Sukh to build something that would put The Lane on a different level. The result speaks for itself.
articles.body:
There's a new standard in non-league football. And it belongs to Rayners Lane FC.

Chairman and owner Pete Singh had a vision. Not just a website. Not just a page with a fixture list and a badge. Something that would make people stop scrolling, sit up, and take notice. Something worthy of The Lane.

To make it happen, Pete turned to a familiar face — Sukh, a former committee member and long-time servant of this club, who now runs CXLLAB LDN, a creative and digital studio operating at the very top of the industry.

"I wanted something that no other non-league club in the country had," Pete said. "I knew Sukh understood this club, understood what we're building here, and I knew he wouldn't settle for ordinary. He never has."

What CXLLAB LDN delivered is nothing short of remarkable. A fully dynamic digital platform — live match scoreboards, auto-generating match day programmes, a squad manager, a club news system, real-time fixtures and league tables, a full commercial investment section, and an editorial aesthetic that rivals clubs three or four levels above us.

The platform runs itself. Manager Gary Pitt updates the squad. Russell updates the programme the night before a home game. Pete activates the live scoreboard at kick-off. No developers needed. No technical knowledge required. Just The Lane, running like a top-flight operation.

"Sukh built this out of love for the club as much as anything," Pete added. "That's what makes it different. You can feel it in every detail."

This is what Rayners Lane FC looks like in 2026. Yellow first. The Lane always. And now — unmistakably — levels above.

Welcome to the new raynerslanefc.co.uk
